echo_sets.name: Chromatic Foam
echo_sets.note: Best set for Fusion Burst mode; provides Fusion DMG Bonus to both Denia and the next Resonator.

echo_sets.name: Pact of Neonlight Leap
echo_sets.note: Best set for Tune Strain mode; easy ATK buff to the next Resonator after Outro, scaling with Tune Break Boost.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Forged Dwarf Star (or Stringmaster / Cosmic Ripples) + 5-piece Chromatic Foam (Fusion Burst) or Pact of Neonlight Leap (Tune Strain) in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Fusion DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and 125% Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Forged Dwarf Star
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature; tailor-made for her two-mode kit. Best in slot.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner 5-star; strong Crit substat and ATK buffs.

ranked_weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
ranked_weapons.note: Limited 5-star alternative; strong stat package for sub-DPS Rectifiers.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star; Energy Regen and team ATK support. Usable stat stick.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: One of the most valuable sub-DPS units in the game; enables both the Fusion Burst and Tune Strain compositions and frees Lynae up for other teams. SS overall on the 3.7 tier list — a top pull for any roster running status or Tune Strain carries.

members.name: Denia
members.note: Fusion Burst sub-DPS; strong off-field Fusion Burst application via Erosion Field and Fusion DMG buffs.

members.name: Aemeath
members.note: Fusion Burst Main DPS who capitalizes on Denia's Fusion DMG and Fusion Burst buffs.

members.name: Lupa
members.note: Fusion support providing additional Fusion buffs and sustain.

teams.name: Premium: Denia + Aemeath + Lupa
teams.rotation: Lupa sets up Fusion buffs, Denia runs her fast sub-DPS loop to deploy Erosion Field and Outro into Aemeath, who takes the field for the Fusion Burst damage window.

members.name: Luuk Herssen
members.note: Tune Strain Main DPS; benefits from Denia's Tune Break Boost and faster Off-Tune buildup.

members.name: Denia

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Best Tune Strain support; Off-Tune Buildup Rate, team damage buffs, and healing.

teams.name: Alternative: Luuk Herssen + Denia + Mornye
teams.rotation: Mornye sets up buffs and sustain, Denia runs her Tune Strain loop to funnel ATK and Tune Break Boost, then Luuk Herssen takes the field for his damage window.
